name: notionctl
description: Security-auditable, zero-dependency command-line interface for Notion, designed to be driven by AI coding agents via shell invocations.

scripts.test: npm run build && cd dist && node --test --test-reporter=spec
scripts.test:unit: npm run build && cd dist && node --test
scripts.test:security: npm run build && cd dist/test/security && node --test
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm run test
